notes.title: CYBER FREEUSE FANTASY: Your imagination, uncensored.
notes.content:
That's right, a new title coming up to the Forbidden World universe... [h1]CYBER FREEUSE FANTASY[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/5dd84b6ded943834a79b3bc2829cecd5c9e686b7.jpg[/img]
Enjoy a setting that celebrates sexual liberation and freedom, allowing you to fully explore and indulge in the free use fantasy.

[h3]Explore a world where anything is possible.[/h3]
5 different scenarios with a brand new comic-style intro to set up the mood for everyone. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/2eb3730ab4fe514a78bc39c56819a55fc07b75c4.gif[/img]

[h3]The freedom to desire, with no limits.[/h3]
Use your mouse, VR controllers or ropes to interact with the characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/1f7e66c9fb14dbcb1e09801816f2cd490c486cb0.gif[/img]

[h3]Free Use knows no rules.[/h3]
Spank away to your hearts desire... these girls are begging for it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768190/a2d700d42387607ecdfa2960d151e7ac0ed3b925.gif[/img]

Want to know more? Cyber FreeUse Fantsy is AVAILABLE TODAY [h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998430/Cyber_Freeuse_Fantasy/]HERE [/url][/h1]so you don't miss out a single update!
